_howTo: Edit this file to update the Calendar. An event with a "date" (YYYY-MM-DD) shows on that day. An event with only a "month" (YYYY-MM) is listed under 'dates to be announced' for that month. "time", "location" and "description" are optional.

events.title: ClubFest
events.description: Come find McMaster AIAA at ClubFest. Check out what we have planned for the year and meet some of the people behind McMaster AIAA.

events.title: Kickoff Event
events.description: A mini conference to kick off McMaster AIAA. Learn from industry professionals from NASA and Bombardier and hear directly from people working in aerospace.

events.title: Workshop 01: Foamboard Glider
events.description: Learn the basics of aerodynamics, design and build your own glider, and put it to the test in a flight-distance competition. No experience needed. Limited spots, so register through the link in our Instagram bio.

events.title: AIAA Region I Student Conference
events.description: Submit an abstract, present your research, and network with aerospace students, engineering professionals, and industry leaders.
